evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct content-based discovery method; no other story expresses the same requirement or contains it.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery differs from similar-user and content-based discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-user source differs from profile and content-based discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Unique input and output combination differentiates it from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and tag-driven discovery is a separate search method.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag upload and availability is a distinct upstream processing goal.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail sequence viewing is unique among user-facing video features.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Broader similarity story is not subsumed by the perceptual-specific story ZO-009.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments; ZO-008: similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in ZO-008; 'perceptually' only narrows the similarity type without another meaningful actor, context, goal, permission, or business-rule difference.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation output and similar-profile sourcing differ from music-search and profile-discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location and news-event recommendation is unique.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification differs from product, logo, and brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a distinct object-detection requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is distinct from other object-identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification differs from person, product, and broadcaster-logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is distinct from other search and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geographic map exploration is unique.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search differs from fingerprinting and content-similarity discovery.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from user-facing segment viewing.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: News-topic annotation is distinct from segmentation editing and filtering.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V-quality-based filtering and ranking is distinct from other prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio edit detection is unique among audio-processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a distinct content-safety rule.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset prefiltering is distinct from high-level metadata and tag prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from other admin filtering and processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata and tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Aesthetic/complexity assessment is distinct from other admin analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Scientist prompt detection is distinct from picture assessment and volunteer interruption stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typing differs from classification weighting and project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is context-specific and distinct from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Snapshot Serengeti empty-animal detection is context-specific and distinct from plankton empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Timestamp-malfunction image series detection is distinct.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification differs from attribute and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification differs from species and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals differs from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation is distinct from species and size/orientation detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Plankton empty-image detection is context-specific and distinct from Snapshot empty-animal detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton size/orientation detection differs from segmentation and species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification differs from size/orientation and segmentation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for video reduction is distinct from egg-laying time detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying time detection is distinct from general worm motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite damage-feature detection is distinct from other image-analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Classification weighting differs from volunteer typing and project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is distinct from semantic filtering and object detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal and Snapshot tasks.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal differs from whale-call analysis and edit detection.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is a distinct domain-specific audio analysis task; no requirement-level duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales differs from grouping whale calls and noise removal.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from education timing and medium choice.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption medium choice is distinct from interruption timing and education medium choice.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing differs from interruption timing and education content/medium.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education medium choice is distinct from interruption medium choice and education timing.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education content selection is distinct from timing and medium choices.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer comment detection differs from Zoonibot communication and scientist prompt stories.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Generic Zoonibot comment timing differs from explanation timing and volunteer comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing differs from generic commenting and explanation content.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot message content selection is distinct from timing and medium choices.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping is distinct from project-specific detection tasks; no duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is distinct from content recommendation and classification weighting.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization/reuse is unique in the backlog.
